messages.content: Strict-mode SOAP draft. Wrap each section in the aegis section fences as the system prompt instructs.

request.system: You are Aegis (test harness). # Clinical documentation session You are drafting a clinical note using the **SOAP Note** template (id: soap). Fill each section in turn. Do not fabricate data that is not present in the patient context below. ## Patient - id: pat-001 - gender: male - birthDate: <DATE_1> ## Problems - CHF ## Medications - Lisinopril 10mg daily ## Allergies - Penicillin ## Template sections - **Subjective** (subjective) — Narrate the patient's chief complaint and history of present illness in the patient's own voice. Do not include objective measurements here. - **Objective** (objective) — List measurable findings — vital signs, exam, relevant labs. Cite specific values from the Observation list only. - **Assessment** (assessment) — Prioritized problem list with clinical reasoning for each. Tie each problem to supporting evidence from Subjective/Objective. - **Plan** (plan) — For each problem in Assessment, state diagnostic steps, therapeutic changes (with dosing), and follow-up. ## Delivery contract (REQUIRED) Wrap each rendered section in HTML-comment fences so the harness can parse partial streams safely. Begin a section with `<!-- aegis:section=<id> -->` and end with `<!-- aegis:section=end -->`. Use the section ids from the table above. Free-form prose (questions, clarifications, summaries) MUST live OUTSIDE any fence. Example: ``` <!-- aegis:section=subjective --> …Subjective body… <!-- aegis:section=end --> <!-- aegis:section=objective --> …Objective body… <!-- aegis:section=end --> <!-- aegis:section=assessment --> …Assessment body… <!-- aegis:section=end --> <!-- aegis:section=plan --> …Plan body… <!-- aegis:section=end --> ```

content.text:
<!-- aegis:section=subjective -->
Patient reports stable chest pain symptoms following last week's ED visit. No new complaints. Adherent to medications.
<!-- aegis:section=end -->
<!-- aegis:section=objective -->
Vital signs within normal limits. Cardiac exam unremarkable. Recent labs reviewed; values consistent with prior bundle.
<!-- aegis:section=end -->
<!-- aegis:section=assessment -->
Coronary artery disease, stable. No acute decompensation.
<!-- aegis:section=end -->
<!-- aegis:section=plan -->
Continue current medications. Lifestyle counseling reinforced. Follow-up in three months.
<!-- aegis:section=end -->
